title: Your day in your words
summary: During Thursday Kumo only keeps notes for the dream: the run with Leo, your own words about it, and a lunch with Mira you mention that was really on Tuesday. That night it writes Thursday's journal as your own diary, in the first person, and adds the lunch to Tuesday's entry where it happened. In the morning you read both days in the Library.
